notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Cast Fiery Mantle by paying {1}{R}, attaching it to any other creature you control.
When Fiery Mantle enters the battlefield, Chishiro triggers, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing the Spirit and the creature that Fiery Mantle is attached to, adding {R}{R}.
Fiery Mantle triggers, returning itself to your hand from your graveyard.
Quintorius triggers, creating a 3/2 Spirit creature token.
Repeat.
